title: Northgate Card Rates and Fees Table — Interest Rates, Interest Charges and Account Fees by Card
content:
Harbor Point Bank, N.A. issues every **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** card on the pricing below. The table states, for each of the six cards, the network the card runs on, its interest rates and the way interest is figured, and the account fees it carries. A value marked "not applicable" means the card has no such feature.

Column key: **Secured** is the Northgate Secured Card, **Store** the Northgate Store Card, **MC** the Northgate Mastercard, **World MC** the Northgate World Mastercard, **Bus. Store** the Northgate Business Store Card and **Bus. MC** the Northgate Business Mastercard.

## Network and interest rates

| Term | Secured | Store | MC | World MC | Bus. Store | Bus. MC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network the card runs on | closed loop (usable only at Northgate) | closed loop (usable only at Northgate) | Mastercard | Mastercard | closed loop (usable only at Northgate) | Mastercard |
| Annual percentage rate on purchase balances in effect for new accounts | 29.99% | 29.99% | 28.49% | 27.49% | 29.99% | 27.99% |
| APR on cash advance balances | not applicable | not applicable | 29.99% | 29.99% | not applicable | 29.99% |
| Penalty APR can ever be applied | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Interest calculation method | average daily balance, including new purchases | same | same | same | same | same |
| Divisor used to turn the APR into a daily periodic rate | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Smallest interest charge assessed in a cycle in which any interest is due | 2.00 USD | 2.00 USD | 2.00 USD | 2.00 USD | 2.00 USD | 2.00 USD |
| Interest-free grace on new purchases requires the previous statement balance to have been paid in full by its due date | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Calendar days of advance notice before an APR increase or other significant change in terms | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |

## Account and transaction fees

| Fee | Secured | Store | MC | World MC | Bus. Store | Bus. MC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Annual account fee | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Minimum cash advance fee per advance | not applicable | not applicable | 10.00 USD | 10.00 USD | not applicable | 10.00 USD |
| Cash advance fee as a percent of the advance (the greater of this and the minimum applies) | not applicable | not applicable | 5% | 5% | not applicable | 5% |
| Fee on purchases processed outside the US | not applicable | not applicable | 0% | 0% | not applicable | 0% |
| Over-the-limit fee (Northgate Cards never charge one; transactions over the limit are declined) | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Fee for a replacement card | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## Notes to the table

- **Daily periodic rate.** The daily periodic rate of a card is its APR divided by 100 and then by the divisor of 365. As a hypothetical illustration only, an APR of 36.50% would give a daily periodic rate of 0.1% (0.001).
- **Cash advance fee.** On the three Mastercard cards a cash advance fee is the greater of 10.00 USD and 5% of the advance. Hypothetical illustration: an advance of 80.00 gives 5% of 4.00, so the 10.00 minimum applies; an advance of 400.00 gives 5% of 20.00, which is above the minimum, so 20.00 applies.
- **Closed-loop cards.** The Secured, Store and Business Store cards run on a closed loop and are usable only at Northgate, so they carry no cash advance rate or fee and no foreign transaction fee.
